name: Haus "Hanni" Gundolf
beschreibung:
Sunnily and quietly situated on a hillside in Brennwald near Wenns, this welcoming home offers cosy rooms and friendly personal attention. It is a peaceful base for discovering the Pitztal.

The Hochzeiger ski and hiking area, the Pitz-Park leisure facility, and alpine trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Hanni Gundolf in Wenns-Brennwald provides nature-filled relaxation in the front of the Pitztal valley.
